user.title: VirtuHome
user.description: Adds the VirtuHome 3D view to the sidebar and the VirtuHome card to your dashboards. Open VirtuHome in the sidebar afterwards to import a scan or draw your home.

card_resource.title: The VirtuHome card is missing from your dashboards

confirm.title: Add the VirtuHome card again
confirm.description: Dashboards load the VirtuHome card from a resource that is missing or names an older version, so VirtuHome cards may show "Custom element doesn't exist: virtuhome-card". Submit to add it again, as VirtuHome does when Home Assistant starts, then reload the dashboard.

missing_entities.title: VirtuHome has devices linked to entities that no longer exist
missing_entities.description: {count} devices, doors, windows or pieces in your VirtuHome home are linked to entities Home Assistant no longer has (renamed, re-paired or removed). Open VirtuHome in the sidebar, then Edit → Home → Check my setup: it can link them to their new entities. This goes away once they are linked.

extension_needs_update.title: A VirtuHome extension can't load
extension_needs_update.description: {count} of your VirtuHome extensions need a newer VirtuHome or could not load. Update VirtuHome and VirtuHome Pro through the Marketplace (or HACS) and restart Home Assistant; Edit → Home → Check my setup in VirtuHome says which. This goes away once they load.

pro_needed.title: Your VirtuHome extensions now come with VirtuHome Pro
pro_needed.description: Since VirtuHome 0.18, extensions come with VirtuHome Pro, an integration of its own, and this Home Assistant has a licence key for them. Open VirtuHome → Edit → Extras → Open in the Marketplace, install VirtuHome Pro and restart Home Assistant. Your key, trials and the automations the extensions added carry on as they were, with nothing to enter again. This goes away once VirtuHome Pro is installed.
